summary: Added focused unit and HTTP integration tests for destination URL normalization, preservation behavior, idempotency, and failure paths.
rationale: The unit tests assert the normalized destination is the one passed to persistence, cover default and non-default ports, case-insensitive UTM removal, preservation of unrelated query parameters and fragments, and verify validation, own-host rejection, persistence errors, and original-request idempotency behavior. The integration tests verify the create response, link details, and redirect all use the normalized destination, and confirm invalid URLs return RFC 7807 ProblemDetails.
content: Added two new test files without changing existing tests: focused `LinkNormalizationTests` and an API integration test class using `IClassFixture<ApiFactory>` and `factory.Client()`.
